correctness.rationale: Cyclic H has exactly S elements, H∩L^*=F_q^*, and K^*=HL^* with multiplicity q-1. Because r≡1 modulo q^n-1, F^m(uz)=u^(r^m)L^m(z) for every positive m. Counting scalar eigenvectors against cyclic power equations gives the displayed exact integer count, and Möbius inversion recovers cycles. Seven direct field tests pass, including characteristics 2 and 3 and nontrivial r. No finite experiment is used to prove the theorem.
